newsitem.title: CROATIA: Final result of Croatian presidential election.
newsitem.headline: Final result of Croatian presidential election.

text.p: Croatian President Franjo Tudjman's vote in Sunday's presidential election, after votes from all but one polling stations were counted, was 61.41 percent, Croatian radio said on Thursday.
In second place was Zdravko Tomac of the Social Democratic party with 21.03 percent and in third place was Vlado Gotovac of the Social Liberal party with 17.56 percent.
The election has to be repeated in the town of Varazdin after an elderly couple voted twice in two different polling stations, an election official said.
The full election results, which gave Tudjman a second five-year term, will be declared official in around a week's time, state radio reported.
